subject.title: marketplace-crons: MercadoLibre degrada listings por image-validator-404 en Bunny CDN

question: Is the current dev implementation enough to close this after a fresh BigQuery check, or should the issue stay open for an upstream MercadoLibre image eligibility/backfill fix?
rationale: The code now classifies and suppresses repeats, but the issue was confirmed live before later mitigations and the remaining first-discovery/backfill boundary needs owner intent and production evidence.

options.title: Verify then close if quiet
options.body: Run a post-PR6503/PR6635 BigQuery check for IMAGE_NOT_FOUND and close only if the create error signature is gone or limited to expected ineligible telemetry.

options.title: Keep for upstream eligibility
options.body: Implement a MercadoLibre preflight/backfill that marks missing or undersized images before the create selector discovers them one-by-one.

options.title: Split data cleanup
options.body: Close the code portion and track catalog image repair/backfill as a separate data-ops item with dry-run gates.

recommendation.title: Verify then close if quiet
recommendation.body: Run a post-PR6503/PR6635 BigQuery check for IMAGE_NOT_FOUND and close only if the create error signature is gone or limited to expected ineligible telemetry.

likelyOwner.reason: Alex is the current assignee and authored the earlier IMAGE_NOT_FOUND/retry-policy fixes.
